summary: This class features a discussion with members of the Kadima SCA mission about their experiences traveling to Israel to support soldiers following the events of October 7th. The speakers share their personal motivations for visiting, the impact of these missions on their own lives, and the importance of educating the younger generation about the history and reality of the state of Israel.
subjects: Resilience of the people of Israel
questions: Why did the speakers decide to travel to Israel during a time of war?
How do these missions impact the soldiers who receive support?
What advice do the speakers have for students facing anti-semitism on campus?
Why is it important for the younger generation to visit Israel?
How can community members who cannot travel still support Israel?
